title: Twist E25: Applicable homogeneous signature baseline with complete output certificates
status_note: Proposed E25; not started. Applicable signature backend, homogenization/saturation adapter and complete-basis checker are not yet pinned. A separate runnable protocol and source/checker pins are required.
blocked_on: note:Applicable signature backend, homogenization/saturation adapter and complete-basis checker are not yet pinned.
question: Can a same-characteristic signature solver be compared fairly after homogenization, saturation and dehomogenization are fully verified and priced?
decision_value: Only verified equal tasks admit a stage comparison. If no applicable signature implementation is available, that baseline remains missing rather than being replaced by a wrong-characteristic run.

resources.notes: Proposed pilot: one CPU, 4 GiB, 30 seconds per engine/system with the same hard envelope for each compared engine. Freeze timeout semantics and record extraction/checking separately before extending the grid. Full resources remain unestimated. The nominal disk field is not an estimate; calibrate and freeze it before readiness.

outputs.result_schema: Not frozen; required evidence fields are in the linked design. No result exists.

env.name: unassigned-native-rust
env.recipe: Design only; implement native driver, independent checker, checkpoints and source/protocol pins before readiness.

funding.rationale: Blocked proposal with no run estimate, below the existing funded seed cards. Adding it changes no runnable-work priority or funding.

cairn.notes: No lab publication, lease, run, resource allocation or funding transaction has been performed. The failing sentinel is intentional.
